brief.goal: a hand-cranked winch: a printed 120x80x6mm base with two 60mm-tall, 6mm-thick side plates; a crank shaft carrying a 15-tooth module-1.5 spur gear that drives a 45-tooth module-1.5 spur gear on a 30mm-diameter rope drum shaft (3:1 reduction); both shafts turn in 608 bearings in the side plates; a 60mm crank arm with a handle
brief.design: Sturdy workshop machine: thick, honest walls, with generous fillets of about 2 mm where plates and bosses meet the base. A 1 mm chamfer goes on exposed outer edges. Round features such as the bosses, hub, drum flanges and handle stay clean cylinders with softened edges, so the winch reads as one robust cast-looking unit rather than a lattice of thin parts.

frame.title: Winch frame
frame.spec: One printed U-frame: a 120x80x6 base plate with a 6mm-thick, 60mm-tall side plate standing at each x end, inner faces facing each other. Both shaft axes run along x at the same height, spaced along y by the gear centre distance. Each bearing position has a round boss that thickens the plate outward only, so the inner faces stay flat. The -x plate has one boss, on the drum axis. The +x plate has two: a drum-axis boss of the same depth, and a deeper crank-axis boss that takes a bearing from each side.

contract.name: Winch frame
contract.summary: Base plus two end side plates in one piece. The drum axis is at y = -shaftSpacing/2 and the crank axis at y = +shaftSpacing/2, both at z = axleHeight. 608 bearing faces sit on both inner plate faces (drum axis) and on the inner and outer faces of the +x plate (crank axis).

artifact.code:
from build123d import *
import math


def xcyl(r, x0, x1, y, z):
    return Pos((x0 + x1) / 2, y, z) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(r, abs(x1 - x0))


def build(p):
    L = p.baseLength
    W = p.baseWidth
    tb = p.baseThickness
    H = p.plateHeight
    tp = p.plateThickness
    za = p.axleHeight
    s = p.shaftSpacing
    rb = p.bossDiameter / 2
    bt = p.bossThickness
    cbt = p.crankBossThickness
    xi = L / 2 - tp  # inner face |x|
    top = tb + H

    base = Pos(0, 0, tb / 2) * Box(L, W, tb)
    pl = Pos(-(L / 2 - tp / 2), 0, top / 2) * Box(tp, W, top)
    pr = Pos(L / 2 - tp / 2, 0, top / 2) * Box(tp, W, top)
    body = base + pl + pr

    yd = -s / 2
    yc = s / 2

    # bosses, outward only
    body = body + xcyl(rb, -xi - bt, -xi, yd, za)
    body = body + xcyl(rb, xi, xi + bt, yd, za)
    body = body + xcyl(rb, xi, xi + cbt, yc, za)

    # bearing pockets (press fit) and shaft bores
    rs_l = (p.j_drum_seat_od - 0.05) / 2
    rs_r = (p.j_drum_far_seat_od - 0.05) / 2
    rs_c = (p.j_crank_in_seat_od - 0.05) / 2
    rbore = 8.3 / 2

    # -x drum
    body = body - xcyl(rs_l, -xi - p.j_drum_seat_w, -xi + 1, yd, za)
    body = body - xcyl(rbore, -xi - bt - 1, -xi + 1, yd, za)
    # +x drum
    body = body - xcyl(rs_r, xi - 1, xi + p.j_drum_far_seat_w, yd, za)
    body = body - xcyl(rbore, xi - 1, xi + bt + 1, yd, za)
    # crank: bearing from each side
    body = body - xcyl(rs_c, xi - 1, xi + p.j_crank_in_seat_w, yc, za)
    body = body - xcyl(rs_c, xi + cbt - p.j_crank_in_seat_w, xi + cbt + 1, yc, za)
    body = body - xcyl(rbore, xi - 1, xi + cbt + 1, yc, za)

    return body

rope-drum.title: Rope drum
rope-drum.spec: Printed rope drum: a 30mm-diameter barrel along its local z axis with a raised flange at each end to keep the rope on. The barrel's -z end sits at z = -length/2 and its +z end at z = +length/2. The drum shaft runs through it on the axis, and the drum turns with it. The 45T gear is fixed against its +z end face. Add a small rope-anchor hole straight across the barrel along y, close to one flange. The far-support port beyond the +z end is a reference point on the shaft axis, short of the +x plate by the retaining collar. Do not model any material there except the drum itself.

contract.name: Rope drum
contract.summary: Flanged drum, axis along local z. Its -z end face sits on the shaft's retaining collar at the -x side plate's drum bearing. Its +z end face carries the 45T gear. far_face lies on the axis one gear thickness plus 2mm beyond the +z end, so the gear sits between the drum and the +x plate's collar.

from build123d import *
import math


def build(p):
    L = p.length
    rb = p.barrelDiameter / 2
    rf = p.flangeDiameter / 2
    tf = p.flangeThickness
    zfar = L / 2 + 12.0  # far-support face at z = 51.5 for default length

    # barrel
    body = Cylinder(rb, L)

    # flanges with softened outer edges
    for s in (-1, 1):
        fl = Cylinder(rf, tf)
        c = min(0.8, tf * 0.25)
        fl = chamfer(fl.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0], c)
        fl = chamfer(fl.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], c)
        body = body + Pos(0, 0, s * (L / 2 - tf / 2)) * fl

    # hub boss beyond +z end carrying the far bore up to the far face
    rboss = 6.5
    hboss = zfar - L / 2 + 0.5
    body = body + Pos(0, 0, L / 2 - 0.5 + hboss / 2) * Cylinder(rboss, hboss)

    # D-flat shaft bore, press fit, flat 3 mm along +x, through drum and boss
    rbore = (p.j_drum_shaft_d - 0.05) / 2
    flat = p.j_drum_flat
    z0 = -L / 2 - 2
    z1 = zfar + 2
    blen = z1 - z0
    bz = (z0 + z1) / 2
    span = 2 * rbore + 2
    keep = Pos((flat - span) / 2, 0, bz) * Box(flat + span, span * 2, blen + 2)
    dbore = (Pos(0, 0, bz) * Cylinder(rbore, blen)) & keep
    body = body - dbore

    # rope anchor hole straight across the barrel along y, close to +z flange
    rh = 1.5
    zc = L / 2 - tf - 4
    body = body - Pos(0, 0, zc) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(rh, 2 * rb + 4)
    body = body - Pos(0, 0, zc + rh / math.sqrt(2)) * Rot(0, 45, 0) * Box(rh, 2 * rb + 4, rh)

    return body

from build123d import *

def build(p):
    gear = involute_gear(p.module, int(p.teeth), p.pressure_angle, p.thickness, p.get("phase", 0))
    flat = p.get("flat", 0)
    nominal = p.get("bore", p.bore)
    if nominal > 0:
        hole = Cylinder((nominal + 0.15) / 2, p.thickness * 2)
        if flat > 0:
            hole = hole - Pos(flat + nominal / 2, 0, 0) * Box(nominal, nominal * 2, p.thickness * 4)
        gear = gear - hole
    return gear

artifact.code:
from build123d import *
import math

def build(p):
    L = p.armLength
    W = p.armWidth
    T = p.armThickness
    hd = p.hubDiameter
    hl = p.hubLength
    gd = p.gripDiameter
    gl = p.gripLength
    sd = p.j_crank_out_shaft_d
    flat = p.j_crank_out_flat

    hr = hd / 2
    gr = gd / 2
    arm_z0 = hl - T

    # Hub: z 0..hl, chamfer its bottom outer edge before any boolean
    hub = Pos(0, 0, hl / 2) * Cylinder(hr, hl)
    hub = chamfer(hub.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0], 1.0)

    # Flat arm from hub centre to grip centre, flush with hub top
    arm = Pos(L / 2, 0, arm_z0 + T / 2) * Box(L, W, T)

    # Grip: cylinder from arm bottom up, with a hemispherical dome on top
    top = hl + gl
    cyl_top = top - gr
    cyl_h = cyl_top - arm_z0
    grip = Pos(L, 0, arm_z0 + cyl_h / 2) * Cylinder(gr, cyl_h)
    grip = grip + Pos(L, 0, cyl_top) * Sphere(gr)

    part = hub + arm + grip

    # D-bore: press fit, flat at +x = flat from axis
    br = (sd - 0.05) / 2
    bore = Pos(0, 0, hl / 2) * Cylinder(br, hl + 0.4)
    keep = Pos(flat - 10, 0, hl / 2) * Box(20, 20, hl + 2)
    bore = bore & keep
    part = part - bore
    return part

Drum shaft far support: one 608 in the +x plate, coaxial with j-drum. far_face sits beyond the gear, so the 45T gear stays between the drum and the plate.
Crank shaft: a 608 in the inner side of the +x crank boss, with the 15T pinion pressed on inside it. This joint shares one axle with j-crank-out.
Crank shaft: a 608 in the outer side of the +x crank boss, with the crank arm pressed onto the shaft end.
